## Setup

```{r}
# Loading packages
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(spData)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")
```

## Part 1

```{r}

#| output: false

# Reading in and cleaning data 
# Reading and cleaning EJScreen data
ejscreen <- st_read(
  here("data",
    "ejscreen",
    "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) |>
  clean_names()

# Reading and cleaning HOLC data
holc <- st_read(
  here("data",
    "mapping-inequality",
    "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json")) |>
  clean_names()

# Read in crashes data 
crashes <- read.csv('data/SWITRS_LA/Crashes.csv')
```

```{r}
#| output: false

# Organizing the grade values 
holc <- holc |>
  mutate( grade = str_extract(as.character(grade), "^[ABCD]"),
    grade = factor(grade, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"))
  )
```
```{r}
# Creating the HOLC Map 

# HOLC grade colors
holc_colors <- c(
  "A" = "#99a9f6",
  "B" = "#adf9b2",
  "C" = "#f6dcf5",
  "D" = "#e619c0")

plot_colors <- c(
  holc_colors,
  "Not graded" = "#999999")

holc_map <- tm_basemap(server = "Esri.WorldTopoMap") +
  tm_shape(holc, is.main = TRUE) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "grade",
    fill_alpha = 0.7,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
      values = holc_colors,
      labels = c("A: Best",
        "B: Desirable",
        "C: Declining",
        "D: Hazardous"
      )),
    fill.legend = tm_legend( title = "Historical HOLC grade",
    ))  +
  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top")) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("right", "bottom")) +
  tm_title("Historical Redlining in Los Angeles")

holc_map # Display map 

```

This map is showing us the neighborhoos and their corresponding HOLC grade, ranging from Best(A) to Hazardous (D)

```{r}
# Filter ejscreen to LA County
ejscreen_filtered <- ejscreen |>
  filter(
    state_name == "California",
    cnty_name == "Los Angeles County"
  ) |>
  mutate(bg_id = row_number())

# Transform data to the same CRS
ejscreen_filtered <- ejscreen_filtered |>
  st_transform(3310) |>
  st_make_valid()

holc_transformed <- holc |>
  select(grade) |>
  st_transform(st_crs(ejscreen_filtered)) |>
  st_make_valid()

# Join HOLC grades to block groups
ej_holc_join <- st_join(
  ejscreen_filtered,
  holc_transformed,
  largest = TRUE,
  left = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# drop geometry and label block groups without a HOLC grade
dropped_geom <- ej_holc_join |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(
    grade = replace_na(as.character(grade), "Not graded"),
    grade = factor(grade, levels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "Not graded")
    ))

# Calculate block counts by grade
grade_summ <- dropped_geom |>
  group_by(grade, .drop = FALSE) |>
  summarise(total_block_groups = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(percentage = total_block_groups /sum(total_block_groups) * 100)

# Display table
kable(grade_summ, col.names = c(
    "HOLC Grade",
    "# of Block Groups",
    "% of Block Groups"),
  digits = 2,
  caption = "LA County census blocks by HOLC grade."
)
```

```{r}
#| output: false

# Mean low income population 
low_income <- dropped_geom |>
  group_by(grade) |>
  summarise(mean_low_income = mean(lowincpct, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
  .groups = "drop")

# Mean PM2.5 
pm25 <- dropped_geom |>
  group_by(grade) |>
  summarise(mean_pm25 = mean(p_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
  .groups = "drop")

# Mean low life expectancy 
low_life_exp <- dropped_geom |>
  group_by(grade) |>
  summarise(mean_lle = mean(p_lifeexppct, na.rm = TRUE),
  .groups = "drop")
```
  ```{r}
  #| output: false

  ggplot(
  low_income, aes(x = grade, y = mean_low_income, fill = grade)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Low Income Population by HOLC Grade",
    x = "HOLC Grade",
    y = "Mean Low Income Population Percent") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
  ```

  ```{r}
  #| output: false

  ggplot(pm25,
  aes(x = grade, y = mean_pm25, fill = grade)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "PM2.5 Percentile by HOLC Grade",
    x = "Assigned HOLC Grade",
    y = "Mean PM2.5 Percentile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
  ```

  ```{r}
  #| output: false

  ggplot(low_life_exp,
  aes(x = grade, y = mean_lle, fill = grade)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Low Life Expectancy by HOLC Grade",
    x = "Assigned HOLC Grade",
    y = "Mean Low-Life-Expectancy Percentile") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
  ```

- Looking at the different plots for low-income populations, low life expectancy, and particualte matter, they are all highest in HOLC grade D areas, which is classified as "Hazardous", and are lowest in HOLC grade A areas, which is considered to be the "Best" areas. This pattern can lead us to believe that there are historical redlining that still have environmental and socioeconomic impacts on those that continue to live in these areas. 

## Part 2 

```{r}
# Clean column names
crashes <- crashes |>
  clean_names()

# look for missing coordinate pairs
coordinate_missing<- crashes |>
  summarise(
    total_observations = n(),
    missing_point_xy = sum(is.na(point_x) | is.na(point_y)),
    missing_long_lat = sum(is.na(longitude) | is.na(latitude))
  )

kable(coordinate_missing)
```

```{r}
# Filter pedestrian or bicycle crashes 
bike_ped_crashes <- crashes |>
  mutate(collision_date = lubridate::ymd(as.character(collision_date)),
    number_killed = as.numeric(number_killed)) |>
  filter(
    collision_date >= as.Date("2020-01-01"),
    collision_date <= as.Date("2025-12-31"),
    pedestrian_accident == "Y" | bicycle_accident == "Y")

# Remove missing coordinates
sf_crashes <- bike_ped_crashes |>
  drop_na(point_x, point_y) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("point_x", "point_y"),
    crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(st_crs(holc_transformed))
```

```{r}
# Join crash points to HOLC grades
crashes_holc <- st_join(
  sf_crashes,holc_transformed |> select(grade))

# keep crashes in the HOLC areas
crashes_graded <- crashes_holc |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(grade))
```


```{r}
# Count crashes in each HOLC grade
most_crashes <- crashes_graded |>
  group_by(grade, .drop = FALSE) |>
  summarise(n_points = n(),.groups = "drop")

# Calculate the percentage in each grade
percent <- most_crashes |>
  mutate(percentage = n_points / sum(n_points) * 100)

kable(percent,
  digits = 1,
  caption = "Pedestrian and bicycle crashes by HOLC grade, 2020–2025.")
```


```{r}
# Visualize crashes
ggplot(data = percent,
  mapping = aes(
    x = grade,
    y = percentage,
    fill = grade
  )) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = holc_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Pedestrian and Bicycle Crashes by HOLC Grade from 2020 to 2025",
    x = "HOLC Grade",
    y = "Percent of Crashes",
    fill = "HOLC Grade"
  )
```
